thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate observed from eu-central-1 gateway (rolling window 5m, 12% -> 47%). Auto-escalation triggered. Link: https://sentry.redwood/issue/abcd1234 :rotating_light:

maya: seeing the spike on the gateway dashboard now. errors are mostly 502/504 timeouts.

jon: confirmed. downstream mlworkers returning 504s and gateway returning 502s. latency up to 8s on some tails.

lee: i'm routing to the ingresses, looks like one euc1 edge-pool is spiking CPU @ 95%. KV cache miss rate also increased.

carla: customer impact: a handful of EU customers reporting degraded completions + higher token costs. CS is already on it. I'm drafting a comms hold.

maya: starting standard mitigation: 1) disable circuit breaker on eu-central gateway to allow retries 2) fail traffic to eu-west fallback pool 3) scale up dedicated mlworkers in euc1. doing 2 now.

jon: heads up — failing traffic shift may hit eu-west capacity. i'm pre-warming a small burst pool in eu-west and us-east now.

deploy-bot: rolling deploy queued: scale mlworker-pool-euc1 +3 instances (image: mlworker:2026.03.14). CI checks passed. ETA ~90s.

maya: switched route policy to prefer eu-west when eu-central >= 5% 5xx. sending small fraction first (10%).

lee: logs from gateway-proxy:
```
2026-03-14T21:45:02Z ERROR upstream read timeout: upstream_id=mlworker-23 conn=0x7f... code=504
2026-03-14T21:45:10Z WARN kvcache miss ratio=0.83 bucket=prefix-ids
```
Most 504s line up with kvcache hot keys.

jon: i'm seeing a pattern: a recent model rollout (variant q8-fp) in euc1 increased KV cache churn due to larger context sharding. rolling it back might reduce pressure.

maya: agree. can we rollback that variant? who owns rollout?

lee: i'm 90% sure rollout was from model-onboard pipeline yesterday — owner is @jon.

jon: yep that was me. rolling back variant to previous checkpoint now. patch command:
```
redwood deploy model --name chat-claude --variant default --rollback-to=20260312-v1
```

carla: CS wants ETA for customer-facing impact. Maya any ballpark?

maya: if rollback completes and new mlworkers stabilize, error rate should drop to baseline in ~5-8 mins. but we'll keep the eu->us fallback if we see persistent tail errors.

deploy-bot: rollback started, jobs: model-onboard:rollback:job-7732. status: in_progress.

incident-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff in 12m. Current incident severity: Sev2. Paging list updated.

pagerduty: Paging maya on-call (Maya Chen) — acknowledged.

lee: after rollback started, observed immediate reduction in kvcache churn metrics. miss ratio down to 0.34 within 90s.

jon: rollback finished. model variant set to 20260312-v1 in euc1.

maya: scaling back fallback: removing forced route after 6 mins of stable metrics.

carla: CS update sent to impacted customers: short-term degraded latency and errors resolved by routing and rollback. asking for any remaining affected customers.

jon: watching ML worker queues — inflight tokens normalizing. no new 504s in last 3m.

maya: closing mitigation loop: 1) rollback complete 2) mlworkers scaled +3 and stable 3) route policy normalized 4) CS comms sent. moving to monitoring phase.

lee: creating a follow-up ticket to adjust model-onboard canary checks: include kvcache churn and per-prefix telemetry. assigning to jon + infra.

carla: postmortem owner? Maya you okay to own, or should SRE own?

maya: i'll own PM and coordinate with jon/lee for technical analysis. expected PM posted within 72h.

jon: noted. i'll add a regression alert on model rollouts that triggers when euc1 kvcache miss > 0.6 for 2m.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> mitigation complete. Severity downgraded to Sev3. If reopened, please reactivate the channel. :white_check_mark:
